meta.title: Faculty Appraisal Blueprint
meta.subtitle: KRA & KPI Framework - Rubrics, Metrics, Weightages & Live Scorecard
meta.role_focus: High-quality teaching, academic delivery, curriculum implementation, student learning outcomes, research, mentoring, evaluation, and contribution to institutional development.

perfBands.meaning: Performance well below the institutional standard; a development plan is mandatory.
Some targets met; clear improvement areas identified with the Deputy Director.
Meets the institutional standard across most KRAs.
Consistently above target; eligible for recognition.

Band_Compliance.title: Deadline / Compliance Rate
Band_Compliance.note: Share of items delivered on or before the deadline. Target 100%.

Band_Syllabus.title: Syllabus Completion within Calendar
Band_Syllabus.note: Average % of syllabus covered by the academic-calendar end date across assigned courses.

Band_TEI.title: Teaching Effectiveness Index (Student Feedback)
Band_TEI.note: Legacy 1.1 TEI% (weight 45% of Teaching). Framework target >= 4/5 = 80%.

Band_Innovation.title: Innovative Pedagogies per Course per Semester
Band_Innovation.note: Framework minimum 2-4 innovations per semester per course (cases, simulations, experiential tasks).

Band_Pending.title: Pending Digital Academic Tasks (count at audit)
Band_Pending.note: Inverse scale - zero pending items (attendance, marks, course files) is the target.

Band_Audit.title: Academic Audit Score
Band_Audit.note: Score awarded by the academic audit / IQAC checklist (0-100%).

Band_COLevel.title: Average CO Attainment Level (0-3)
Band_COLevel.note: Legacy 1.3.6. OBE attainment levels 0-3; institutional benchmark = Level 2.

Band_Pass.title: Course Pass Percentage
Band_Pass.note: Legacy 1.2 Student performance in university exams (10% of Teaching).

Band_Sessions.title: Mentoring Sessions per Semester
Band_Sessions.note: Framework minimum 2-3 structured sessions per semester per mentor group.

Band_Improve.title: Weak-Mentee Improvement Rate
Band_Improve.note: % of mentees flagged at-risk at the start of term who improved (CGPA / attendance / engagement).

Band_Response.title: Student Query Response within 48 Hours
Band_Response.note: Measured from the query log / LMS helpdesk timestamps.

Band_MenteeAttendance.title: Overall Mentee Attendance
Band_MenteeAttendance.note: Framework KPI: overall attendance of all mentees together above 85%.

Band_MenteePass.title: Overall Mentee Pass Percentage
Band_MenteePass.note: Framework KPI: pass % of mentees together above 90%.

Band_Communication.title: Communication Index (mentees with zero yellow cards)
Band_Communication.note: Yellow-card / black-point system for communication lapses, plus informal assessment.

Band_Activity.title: Activities Conducted (count)
Band_Activity.note: Outreach programmes or placement-support activities in the review period.

Legacy_Placement.title: Legacy 3.1.2 - Mentees with Placement Offers (% -> points)

Legacy_SpecialKey.title: Legacy 4.3 - Special Assignments Scoring Key
Legacy_SpecialKey.note: Verbatim legacy key: 1 PME=1 ->20, 1 SME=2 ->40, 1 EE=3 ->60, 2 SME=4 ->80, 2 EE=6 ->100.

components.name: Teaching, Learning & Academic Delivery
components.focus: Effective and timely delivery of assigned courses.
components.intent: Measures how well, how punctually and how innovatively the faculty member delivers assigned courses, as experienced by students and evidenced in the LMS.
components.sources: Academic calendar, LMS (course plans, attendance, digital tools), student feedback (TEI), class observation.

kpis.name: Course plan submission & adherence
kpis.doc: Course plan submission and adherence rate (target: 100%)
kpis.definition: Course/session plans for every assigned course submitted before term start and sessions delivered as planned.
kpis.measure: (Course plans submitted on time AND sessions delivered as per plan) / total assigned courses
kpis.evidence: Approved course plan per course; LMS session-delivery log; Deputy Director sign-off.
kpis.legacy: 1.3.1 Adherence to set timelines for submission of academic documents (EE/SME/PME/DME)

kpis.name: Syllabus completion within academic calendar
kpis.doc: Completion of syllabus within academic calendar timelines
kpis.definition: Proportion of the prescribed syllabus completed by the academic-calendar end date.
kpis.measure: Average % of syllabus units completed by the calendar cut-off across assigned courses
kpis.evidence: Course coverage report from LMS; completion certificate countersigned by Deputy Director.

kpis.name: Quality of teaching delivery - student feedback (TEI)
kpis.doc: Quality of teaching delivery (student feedback score: target ≥ 4/5)
kpis.definition: Teaching Effectiveness Index from structured student feedback, averaged across all courses taught.
kpis.measure: Average TEI % of all courses (auto-filled from the Course Register; 4/5 = 80%)
kpis.evidence: Course-wise student feedback report (feedback system export).
kpis.legacy: 1.1 Students' Evaluation of Faculty - TEI % (Faculty) & TEI % (Dean); 45% of Teaching

kpis.name: Use of innovative pedagogies
kpis.doc: Use of innovative pedagogies (cases, simulations, experiential tasks) Minimum: 2–4 innovations per semester per course
kpis.definition: Cases, simulations, role plays, live projects, flipped/experiential tasks introduced per course.
kpis.measure: Average number of documented innovations per course per semester
kpis.evidence: Innovation log with session plan reference, student artefacts / photos, LMS activity link.

kpis.name: Class schedule compliance & punctuality
kpis.doc: Compliance with class schedule & attendance (≥ 95% punctuality)
kpis.definition: Sessions started on time and conducted as per timetable (no unapproved cancellations).
kpis.measure: Sessions engaged on time / total scheduled sessions
kpis.evidence: Timetable vs biometric / LMS attendance log; class-monitor report.

kpis.name: Class decorum & professional grooming
kpis.doc: Maintaining class decorum and grooming
kpis.definition: Maintains classroom discipline, professional conduct and institutional dress code.
kpis.measure: Deputy Director rating on the 5-level rubric (observation + incident register)
rubric: Exemplary decorum; zero incidents; role model for students and peers.
Consistently professional; zero incidents; proactive classroom management.
Professional conduct; minor lapses corrected on first feedback.
Repeated lapses in decorum or grooming noted.
kpis.evidence: Class observation notes; incident register (nil report).

kpis.name: Digital / online tools for assessment & engagement
kpis.doc: Use of digital/online learning tools for assessments and engagement
kpis.definition: Effective use of LMS quizzes, polls, discussion forums, simulations and analytics in teaching.
kpis.measure: Rubric rating based on LMS usage analytics and observation
rubric: Every course uses >= 3 digital tools; analytics used to adapt teaching; shares practice with peers.
Every course uses 2-3 digital tools for both assessment and engagement.
Every course uses at least one digital assessment and one engagement tool.
Digital tools used in some courses only, mainly for content upload.
No meaningful use of digital tools beyond mandatory uploads.
kpis.evidence: LMS analytics report; sample quizzes / forums / simulation links.

kpis.name: Zero pending digital academic tasks
kpis.doc: Zero pending digital academic tasks (attendance, marks, course files)
kpis.definition: Attendance, internal marks and course files are complete and current in the LMS at audit.
kpis.measure: Number of pending digital items found at the audit cut-off date
kpis.evidence: LMS pending-task report at audit cut-off.

components.name: Curriculum Implementation & CO–PO Outcome Achievement
components.focus: Aligns with Deputy Director’s academic delivery governance.
components.intent: Ensures every course is designed and assessed against defined Course Outcomes mapped to Programme Outcomes, and that those outcomes are actually attained.
components.sources: OBE / CO-PO mapping sheets, academic audit, LMS uploads, university / end-term results.

kpis.name: Accuracy & completeness of CO-PO mapping
kpis.doc: Accuracy and completeness of CO–PO mapping for assigned courses
kpis.definition: Every assigned course has COs written with action verbs and a justified CO-PO correlation matrix.
kpis.measure: Audit rating of the CO-PO mapping documents on the 5-level rubric
rubric: All courses mapped; justification for every correlation; adopted as a model by IQAC.
All courses mapped with justification; minor edits only.
All courses mapped; some correlations lack justification.
Mapping incomplete for one or more courses.
kpis.evidence: CO-PO matrix per course; IQAC audit checklist.

kpis.name: Quality of CO-PO aligned assessments
kpis.doc: Quality of CO–PO aligned assessments (faculty audit score)
kpis.definition: Assessments (quizzes, assignments, exams) are tagged to COs and cover all COs adequately.
kpis.measure: Faculty academic-audit score for assessment alignment (0-100%)
kpis.evidence: Assessment blueprint with CO tags; audit score sheet.
kpis.legacy: Linked to 1.3.3 Quality of Question Paper & Evaluation

kpis.name: Achievement of defined learning outcomes
kpis.doc: Achievement of defined learning outcomes (course outcome attainment ≥ benchmark)
kpis.definition: Course outcomes are attained at or above the institutional benchmark and students pass the course.
kpis.measure: Weighted average of 2.3.1 CO attainment and 2.3.2 pass %
kpis.evidence: CO attainment calculation sheet; result analysis.
kpis.legacy: 1.3.6 Average CO Attainment Levels Achieved + 1.2 Student's Academic Performance in Course

children.name: Average CO attainment level achieved
children.definition: Average attainment level (0-3) across all COs of all assigned courses.

children.name: Student pass percentage in assigned courses
children.doc: (legacy) Student's Academic Performance in Course - Total Pass %
children.definition: Average pass % across assigned courses (auto-filled from the Course Register).
children.legacy: 1.2 Student's Academic Performance in Course - Total Pass % (10% of Teaching)

kpis.name: Timely LMS upload of course files, session plans & materials
kpis.doc: Timely submission and uploading on LMS of course files, session plans, and learning materials (100%)
kpis.definition: Course file, session plans and learning materials uploaded to the LMS by the stipulated dates.
kpis.measure: Items uploaded by deadline / items required
kpis.evidence: LMS upload log with timestamps.

components.name: Assessment, Examination & Evaluation Duties
components.focus: To support the Deputy Director’s exam & evaluation coordination efforts.
components.intent: Covers the integrity, quality and timeliness of question papers, evaluation, marks upload and feedback to students.
components.sources: Exam cell deadlines, question-paper audit, LMS marks upload log, assignment feedback timestamps.

kpis.name: Timely question papers & answer keys
kpis.doc: Timely preparation of question papers and answer keys (100% deadline compliance)
kpis.definition: Question papers, schemes of evaluation and answer keys submitted to the exam cell by deadline.
kpis.measure: Papers submitted by deadline / papers assigned
kpis.evidence: Exam-cell submission register.

kpis.name: Quality score of question papers
kpis.doc: Quality score of question papers (based on academic audit: Bloom’s taxonomy, coverage, difficulty mix)
kpis.definition: Question papers balance Bloom's levels, cover all units/COs and have an appropriate difficulty mix.
kpis.measure: Question-paper audit score (0-100%)
kpis.evidence: QP audit checklist (Bloom's level map, CO coverage, difficulty index).

kpis.name: Timely evaluation, marks upload & result submission
kpis.doc: Timely completion of evaluation, internal marks upload on LMS, and result submission
kpis.definition: Evaluation completed and internal marks / results uploaded to the LMS within the notified window.
kpis.measure: Evaluations completed & uploaded on time / total evaluations
kpis.evidence: LMS marks-upload log; exam-cell result receipt.

kpis.name: Rubric-based evaluation accuracy & documentation
kpis.doc: Rubric-based evaluation accuracy and documentation completeness
kpis.definition: Evaluation follows published rubrics; re-evaluation variance is low; scripts and records are complete.
kpis.measure: Deputy Director rating after sample re-check of evaluated scripts
rubric: Rubrics published for all components; re-check variance < 5%; complete records.
Rubrics used throughout; variance 5-10%; records complete.
Rubrics used for major components; variance 10-15%; minor gaps in records.
Inconsistent use of rubrics; variance > 15% or records incomplete.
No rubric-based evaluation; significant errors or missing records.
kpis.evidence: Rubrics; sample of evaluated scripts; moderation / re-check report.
kpis.legacy: 1.3.3 Quality of Question Paper & Evaluation (evaluation part)

kpis.name: Assignment feedback within 3 days
kpis.doc: Timely submission of assignment feedback (within 3 days)-100% compliance.
kpis.definition: Graded feedback returned to students within 3 working days of the submission deadline.
kpis.measure: Assignments with feedback within 3 days / total assignments
kpis.evidence: LMS grading timestamps.

components.name: Student Mentoring, Support & Engagement
components.focus: Student academic/career guidance and performance tracking.
components.intent: Holds the mentor accountable for the whole journey of the mentee group: regularity, results, discipline, grooming, communication, internships, placements and achievements.
components.sources: Mentoring register, mentee dashboards, attendance & results, discipline register, placement cell.

kpis.name: Completion of mentoring sessions
kpis.doc: Completion of mentoring sessions (minimum: 2–3 per semester)
kpis.definition: Structured one-to-one / group mentoring sessions held with the mentor group.
kpis.measure: Average number of documented sessions per semester
kpis.evidence: Mentoring register with dates, attendees and action points.

kpis.name: Mentoring reports & progress dashboards on time
kpis.doc: Submission of mentoring reports and student progress dashboards on time
kpis.definition: Mentoring reports and mentee progress dashboards submitted by the stipulated dates.
kpis.measure: Reports submitted on time / reports due
kpis.evidence: Report submission log.

kpis.name: Improvement in mentee performance / engagement
kpis.doc: Improvement in mentee academic performance or engagement metrics
kpis.definition: At-risk mentees identified at term start show measurable improvement by term end.
kpis.measure: At-risk mentees improved / at-risk mentees identified
kpis.evidence: Before/after CGPA, attendance and engagement data for flagged mentees.

kpis.name: Responsiveness to student queries (48 hours)
kpis.doc: Responsiveness to student queries (within 48 hours)
kpis.definition: Mentee / student queries acknowledged and resolved or routed within 48 hours.
kpis.measure: Queries responded within 48 h / total queries
kpis.evidence: Query log / LMS helpdesk timestamps.

kpis.name: Contribution to mentee's overall development
kpis.doc: Contribution to mentee’s overall development as indicated by academic regularity & progress, improvements in weak areas, internship/placement performance.
kpis.definition: Composite of eight mentee-outcome indicators defined in the framework (KPI 1-8).
kpis.measure: Weighted average of 4.5.1 - 4.5.8
kpis.evidence: See sub-KPIs.

children.name: Overall attendance of mentees (> 85%)
children.doc: KPI 1: Overall attendance % of all  mentees together - above 85%
children.definition: Aggregate attendance of the entire mentor group.
children.evidence: LMS attendance report for mentor group.

children.name: Pass % of mentees (> 90%)
children.doc: KPI 2: Pass % of each mentees together above 90%
children.definition: Share of mentees who cleared all courses in the review period.
children.measure: Mentees passed in all courses / total mentees

children.name: Discipline cases among mentees (target 0)
children.doc: KPI 3: Discipline of the mentees - 0 cases

children.name: Grooming cases among mentees (target 0)
children.doc: KPI 4: Grooming of the mentees - 0 cases
children.definition: Dress-code / grooming violations recorded against mentees.

children.name: Premium internships & PPOs
children.doc: KPI 5: Number of mentees’ internships in premium companies outside Kerala - PPOs
children.definition: Internship reach of the mentor group, rewarding premium internships outside Kerala and PPOs.
children.measure: Points from internship %, premium internships and PPOs; full score at 60 points
children.evidence: Internship offer letters; PPO letters; placement-cell confirmation.
children.legacy: 3.1.1 % of mentees who secured internship in approved companies (0-30 pts)

children.name: % of mentees with internship in approved companies
Mentees with premium internships outside Kerala
Pre-Placement Offers (PPOs) received by mentees
Premium placements (Fortune 500) & total CTC
children.doc: KPI 6: Number of students with premium placement - Fortune 500 companies. (Total of CTC)
children.definition: Placement outcomes of mentees, with extra credit for Fortune-500 / premium recruiters and CTC.
children.measure: Points from placement %, premium placements and total CTC; full score at 60 points
children.legacy: 3.1.2 % of mentees who received placement offer letters (0-30 pts)

children.name: % of mentees with placement offers
Mentees placed in Fortune-500 / premium companies
Total CTC of premium placements (Rs. lakh p.a.)
Communication skills of mentees (yellow-card index)
children.doc: KPI 7: Communication skills of the mentees - Yellow card or any other method ( black points or can we think of informal way of assessing)
children.definition: A yellow card (black point) is issued for each communication lapse (non-English use in campus, poor presentation etiquette, unprofessional email). Index = mentees with zero cards.
children.measure: Mentees with zero yellow cards / total mentees (+ informal assessment by Dy Director)

children.name: Mentee publications, presentations, awards & recognitions
children.doc: KPI 8: Publications, conference, awards and recognitions
children.definition: Achievements of mentees in fests, competitions, conferences and journals.
children.measure: Points from legacy multipliers (with legacy caps); full score at 30 points

children.name: Awards / recognitions won by mentees in management fests / external competitions
Publications / conference presentations by mentees
Mentee publications in peer-reviewed journals of repute

components.name: Research, Publications & Academic Contributions
components.intent: Recognises publications, scholarly participation, books, cases, consultancy, IP and doctoral work. Legacy Research (2.x) and Consultancy (4.1, 4.2) point systems are retained.
components.sources: Publication proofs (DOI / indexing), certificates, consultancy receipts (accounts), patent office records, university records.

kpis.name: Research publications - journals & conference papers
kpis.doc: Number of research publications (journals, cases, conferences) per year Benchmark: 2 papers/year (as per institutional norms from time to time)
kpis.definition: Peer-reviewed journal articles and papers presented at conferences, weighted by venue quality.
kpis.measure: Sum of equivalent points (legacy 2.1 & 2.3.1-2.3.3); full score at 80 points (= 2 Scopus papers)
kpis.evidence: Published paper / acceptance letter; indexing proof (ABDC, Scopus, WoS, UGC-CARE); conference certificate.
kpis.legacy: 2.1 Publication in National & International Journals (30% of Research) and 2.3.1-2.3.3 paper presentations

children.name: Publications in ABDC-listed journals
Publications in Scopus / Web of Science indexed journals
Publications in UGC-CARE listed journals
Publications in peer-reviewed journals of repute
Publications in any standard journal
Papers presented - conferences of reputed international agencies
Papers presented - conferences of reputed national agencies
Papers presented - conferences hosted by universities / colleges

kpis.name: Participation in research workshops, FDPs, conferences & invited talks
kpis.doc: Participation in research workshops, FDPs, or conferences
kpis.definition: Continuous professional development and scholarly visibility.
kpis.measure: Sum of equivalent points (legacy 2.3.4-2.3.7); full score at 40 points
kpis.evidence: Participation certificates; invitation letters.
kpis.legacy: 2.3 Participation in conferences / seminars / workshops (20% of Research)

children.name: Conferences / workshops / FDPs attended - duration above 1 week
Conferences / workshops / FDPs attended - less than 1 week
Invited lectures / presentations - reputed international agencies
Invited lectures / presentations - reputed national agencies

kpis.name: Case writing, books & chapters, consultancy & applied projects
kpis.doc: Contribution to case writing, book chapters, consultancy, or applied projects
kpis.definition: Applied scholarship: books, chapters, teaching cases and revenue-earning consultancy / training.
kpis.measure: Sum of points (legacy 2.2 books, legacy 4.1 revenue table, new case points); full score at 100 points
kpis.evidence: Book / chapter with ISBN; case registration (Case Centre / Ivey / HBP); consultancy agreement & accounts receipt.
kpis.legacy: 2.2 Books / Chapters (20% of Research) + 4.1 Consultancy, Training, Sponsored Projects (50% of Sec. 4)

children.name: Books - international publishers with peer review (sole author)
Books - international publishers with peer review (co-author)
Books - national publishers / State or Central Govt, ISBN (sole author)
Books - national publishers / State or Central Govt, ISBN (co-author)
Subject books - local publishers with ISBN (sole author)
Subject books - local publishers with ISBN (co-author)
Chapters in edited volumes - international publishers (sole author)
Chapters in edited volumes - international publishers (co-author)
Teaching cases registered with international case repositories
Teaching cases published in national / institutional case collections
Consultancy / training / sponsored-project revenue to institution (Rs.)
Applied / industry projects completed (non-revenue)

kpis.name: Industry-linked research, research cell & IP
kpis.doc: Initiation/participation in industry-linked research or institutional research cells
kpis.definition: Research with industry partners, grant seeking, research-cell leadership and intellectual property.
kpis.measure: Sum of points; full score at 50 points
kpis.evidence: MoU / project sanction letter; grant proposal acknowledgement; research-cell minutes; patent filing / grant certificate.
kpis.legacy: 4.2 No. of Patents registered (10 pts each; 25% of Sec. 4)

children.name: Industry-sponsored / collaborative research projects (PI / Co-PI)
Research grant proposals submitted to funding agencies
Research-cell initiatives led (seminar series, working papers, data labs)
Patents filed / published
Patents granted / registered

kpis.name: Doctoral qualification & research supervision
kpis.doc: (Legacy section retained) PhD Completion / Research Guidance
kpis.definition: Faculty's own doctoral progress and supervision of research scholars.
kpis.measure: Sum of legacy 2.5 points; full score at 100 points
kpis.evidence: PhD award notification / thesis submission receipt; university guideship letter; scholar list.
kpis.legacy: 2.5 PhD Completion / Research Guidance (10% of Research)

children.name: PhD degree awarded to faculty during review period
PhD thesis submitted by faculty during review period
Research scholars awarded PhD under guidance
Research scholars who submitted thesis under guidance
Research scholars under guidance (max 2)

components.name: Institutional & Departmental Responsibilities
components.focus: Supporting Deputy Director’s academic operations and overall governance.
components.intent: Captures committee / club / LOT work, events, admissions, outreach, placement support, accreditation and special assignments from the Director.
components.sources: Committee minutes, LOT reports, event reports, admission office, IQAC, Director's assignment register.

kpis.name: Committees, clubs & LOT responsibilities
kpis.doc: Execution of assigned committees /club/LOT responsibilities (activity completion rate) Number of activities and tangible benefits to LOT/club members
kpis.definition: Delivery of the annual plan of assigned committees / clubs / Lead Operating Team.
kpis.measure: Weighted average of 6.1.1 - 6.1.3
kpis.evidence: See sub-KPIs.
kpis.legacy: 3.4 Performance in LOT (20%) + 3.5 Clubs, Professional Memberships, Alumni (10%)

children.name: Activity completion rate of assigned committees / clubs / LOT
children.definition: Planned activities completed vs the approved annual plan.
children.evidence: Annual activity plan and completion report.

children.name: Quality of contribution in Lead Operating Team (LOT)
children.doc: LOT responsibilities - tangible benefits to LOT members
children.definition: Ownership, initiative and tangible outcomes delivered in the LOT.
rubric: Led LOT initiatives with measurable institutional impact; mentors other members.
Owned and delivered all assigned LOT tasks with visible outcomes.
Completed assigned LOT tasks on time.
Did not deliver assigned LOT tasks.
children.evidence: LOT minutes; task tracker; outcome report.
children.legacy: 3.4 Performance in Lead Operating Team (Excellent..Below Average = 100..0)

children.name: Clubs, professional memberships & alumni roles
children.doc: Number of activities and tangible benefits to club members
children.definition: Activities run as club coordinator / professional-body or alumni official and benefits to members.
rubric: >= 6 activities with tangible member benefits (certifications, competitions won, industry access).
children.evidence: Club activity reports; membership certificates; alumni event reports.
children.legacy: 3.5 Performance in Clubs, Professional Memberships, Alumni as officials

kpis.name: Organising academic events, seminars, FDPs & industry talks
kpis.doc: Organizing/coordinating academic events, seminars, FDPs, industrial talks (contribution of the mentor group - lead role or supportive role)
kpis.definition: Conceiving, securing sponsorship for and running academic events, with lead / support role recognised.
kpis.measure: Sum of points (legacy 2.4 + new lead/support points); full score at 80 points
kpis.evidence: Event brochure, sanction / sponsorship letter, attendance, event report.
kpis.legacy: 2.4 Organizing International / National Conferences, Seminars, Workshops (20% of Research)

children.name: Sponsored international / national conferences organised
International / national conferences organised
FDP / training / knowledge-transfer sessions for in-house faculty organised
Proposals submitted for sponsorship of international / national conferences
Proposals submitted for international / national FDPs / MDPs
Seminars / industry talks / guest lectures coordinated - lead role
Seminars / industry talks / guest lectures coordinated - supportive role

kpis.name: Admissions, outreach & placement support
kpis.doc: Contribution to admissions- (No of admissions), outreach (details of the prog conducted), and placement support activities
kpis.definition: Contribution to the institution's intake and placement engine.
kpis.measure: Weighted average of 6.3.1 - 6.3.3
kpis.evidence: See sub-KPIs.
kpis.legacy: 3.2 Contribution to Student Admission (20% of Institutional Development)

children.name: Admissions - references converted by mentor group
children.definition: Candidate references from the faculty / mentor group converted to confirmed admissions.
children.legacy: 3.2.1 No. of references converted to confirmed admission by the Mentor Group (verbatim table)

children.name: Outreach programmes conducted
children.definition: School / college / corporate outreach programmes conducted for brand and admissions.
children.measure: Number of outreach programmes (details in evidence)
children.evidence: Programme report with date, venue, audience, leads generated.

children.name: Placement support activities
children.definition: Corporate connects, recruiter leads, mock interviews, CV clinics supporting placements.

kpis.name: Accreditation, NAAC / NBA / IQAC / NIRF documentation
kpis.doc: Participation in accreditation, NAAC/NBA/IQAC documentation as assigned (Criteria Champion or support role)
kpis.definition: Quality and timeliness of accreditation, ranking and B-school survey work as Criteria Champion or support.
kpis.measure: Rubric rating (role-sensitive)
rubric: Criteria Champion: criterion file complete, audit-ready, zero observations; drives team.
Champion with minor observations, or Support role with outstanding, early delivery.
Assigned documentation complete and on time.
Documentation delayed or incomplete; needed rework.
kpis.evidence: IQAC assignment letter; criterion file; peer-review / audit observations.
kpis.legacy: 3.3 Contribution in Accreditation, NIRF ranking & B-School Surveys (Excellent..Below Average)

kpis.name: Special assignments entrusted by the Director
kpis.doc: (Legacy section retained) Special Assignments Undertaken during the period
kpis.definition: Ad-hoc institutional assignments, each rated by the Director on EE / SME / PME / DME.
kpis.measure: Rating points (EE=3, SME=2, PME=1, DME=0) converted with the legacy scoring key
kpis.evidence: Assignment order and completion note.
kpis.legacy: 4.3 Special Assignments (25% of Sec. 4; up to 6 assignments; scoring key)

children.name: Assignments rated Exceeds Expectations (EE)
Assignments rated Successfully Meets (SME)
Assignments rated Partially Meets (PME)
Assignments rated Does Not Meet (DME)

components.name: Projects, Internships, SIP/CP Support & Evaluation
components.focus: Supports Deputy Director’s coordination of internships and projects.
components.intent: Ensures every guided student has an approved plan and external guide, is monitored, fairly evaluated and completes the internship / project well.
components.sources: Project register, SIP/CP monitoring reports, viva records, industry-mentor evaluations.

kpis.name: Timely enablement of projects - external guides & plans
kpis.doc: Timely enablement of projects external guides and project plans
kpis.definition: Guided students have an approved project plan and confirmed external guide by the deadline.
kpis.measure: Students with approved plan & guide by deadline / students guided
kpis.evidence: Project register; guide confirmation emails.

kpis.name: Quality of project evaluation, viva & documentation
kpis.doc: Quality of project evaluation, viva, and documentation
kpis.definition: Fair, rubric-based project evaluation and viva with complete documentation.
kpis.measure: Rubric rating
rubric: Rubric-based evaluation with external validation; exemplary records; plagiarism checks for all.
Rubric-based evaluation; complete records and plagiarism reports.
Gaps in rubric use or documentation.
Evaluation / viva records missing or disputed.
kpis.evidence: Evaluation rubric sheets; viva records; plagiarism reports.

kpis.name: SIP / CP monitoring & review reports
kpis.doc: Completion of SIP/CP monitoring and review reports (100%)
kpis.definition: Monitoring and review reports for every Summer Internship / Corporate Project student filed on time.
kpis.measure: Reports completed / reports due
kpis.evidence: SIP/CP monitoring log.

kpis.name: Student internship performance & completion
kpis.doc: Student internship performance and completion rate
kpis.definition: Outcome of guided internships: completion and industry-mentor rating.
kpis.measure: Weighted average of 7.4.1 - 7.4.2
kpis.evidence: See sub-KPIs.

children.name: Internship completion rate of guided students
children.definition: Guided students completing internship with certificate.

children.name: Average industry-mentor evaluation of guided students
children.definition: Average score given by industry mentors to guided students.

components.name: Management Overall Assessment
components.focus: Holistic assessment by top management (retained from legacy Section 5).
components.intent: Lets the Director recognise attitude, values, collegiality and institutional citizenship that metrics miss.
components.sources: Director's holistic judgement, Deputy Director recommendation.

kpis.name: Overall assessment by top management
kpis.doc: (Legacy section retained) 5.1 Overall Performance Assessment
kpis.definition: Holistic rating of professionalism, values, teamwork, initiative and alignment with LEAD's mission.
kpis.measure: Director rating on the 5-level rubric (faculty self-rates and Dy Director recommends)
rubric: Exemplary institutional citizen; champions LEAD's mission beyond role.
Highly committed; positive influence on peers and students.
Reliable, collegial and aligned with institutional values.
Needs improvement in attitude, teamwork or initiative.
kpis.evidence: Not required (management judgement); Dy Director note.
kpis.legacy: 5.1 Overall Assessment by Top Management (multiplication factor 10)

weightRationale: Assistant Professors carry the heaviest teaching, mentoring and project-guidance load, so KRAs 1-4 and 7 hold 70% of their FPI.
Associate Professors and Professors are expected to lead scholarship and institution building: KRA 5 rises to 25% and KRA 6 to 18%.

Visiting Faculty are assessed on what they control - classroom delivery, curriculum and evaluation (75%) - plus research visibility and project guidance; mentoring and institutional KRAs are set to 0%.
Management Overall Assessment keeps the legacy top-management voice (legacy 5%; visiting 20% reduced to 10% because the legacy visiting column summed to 120%).
Legacy Consultancy (15% / 20%) is folded into KRA 5 (consultancy revenue, patents) and KRA 6 (special assignments), as agreed.
All weights are editable on this sheet; the scorecard, dashboard and checks recalculate automatically.
